scope: Refresh route-specific public evidence across LibreDWG, ACadSharp, GDAL, and ezdxf; distinguish format transport, explicit geometry projection, ACIS carrier retention, B-rep interpretation, and native acceptance.

method.kind: Primary project documentation, release-note, issue, and pull-request state review
method.evidenceBoundary: Public docs and peer reports establish published route boundaries and release/issue state only. No peer runtime was reproduced. LibreDWG issue #1411 names an older build and must not be generalized to 0.14.1; ACadSharp issue #1195 names 3.4.9 and must not be generalized to v3.8.0. No libdxfrw defect or support claim was established.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG inline SAT export and separate AcDs route
observed: LibreDWG 0.14.1 release notes report an off-by-one fix that had dropped the last SAT block on DXF export.
The same release notes report a 3DSOLID block-size bounds fix and additional DWG/DXF malformed-input and security fixes.

Issue #1411 remains open and describes loss of the separate R2013+ AcDs/SAB route in the reporter's specifically pinned 0.14.8593 build at commit 8a1ae764, with a generated AC1032 DXF route and a separate confidential R2018 example.
doesNotEstablish: that LibreDWG 0.14.1 still loses the #1411 payload
that an inline SAT block fix supports AcDs structure or linkage
that any peer result is evidence for libdxfrw without a local reproducer
evidence.planUse: Keep inline SAT and DWG AcDs cases distinct. Retain last-chunk, exact length/count, bounds, sentinel, and handle-to-AcDs closure controls in their existing owners. Recheck only against an immutable peer build when useful.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp released capability versus proposed ACIS writer work
observed: The latest listed v3.8.0 release is signed and its listed change is InternalsVisibleTo for the ACadSharp.Formats assembly.
Issue #1195 reports silent 3DSOLID/REGION omission by the 3.4.9 DWG-to-DXF writer, including solid-only blocks.
PR #1240 remains open and undeployed and depends on separate ACDS/ACIS schema work.
doesNotEstablish: the current v3.8.0 runtime behavior for the issue's files or family
released ACIS DXF writer support from an open PR
a libdxfrw defect from a peer writer's omission
evidence.planUse: Keep ACadSharp as an exact-pin structural comparator only for demonstrated routes. Preserve per-handle/type/block output inventories and INSERT target closure; keep its open PR out of release capability claims.

evidence.topic: GDAL DXF parsing, projection, and raw ASM boundary
observed: GDAL documentation says Binary DXF reading starts in GDAL 3.12 and that its DXF writer emits AutoCAD 2004 format.
The driver projects selected explicit entities to OGR geometries, maps polyface meshes to polyhedral surfaces, and tessellates curves.
By default, it skips 3DSOLID, REGION, BODY, and SURFACE; AC1027+ 3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE can expose raw ASMData and a 12-value affine ASMTransform without interpreting the shape.
The docs identify a no-option ogr2ogr binary-to-ASCII direct translation path, which is not itself a semantic reader result.
doesNotEstablish: full CAD graph, exact curve, hatch appearance, or arbitrary entity fidelity
ACIS B-rep interpretation, DWG parsing, or AcDs linkage
that Binary DXF parsing and raw ASM extraction compose in every build
evidence.planUse: Keep optional explicit-geometry, raw-carrier, and syntax/transcode observations separate. Use the actual DXF driver/API with pinned build/options for a parse result; never count direct conversion as parsing.

evidence.topic: ezdxf ACIS generated-mesh and projection transformations
observed: The current stable docs say mesh_from_body returns only flat polygonal faces; curved surfaces require a geometry kernel and are lost in that projection.
body_from_mesh creates a solid or shell based on edge adjacency and automatically merges coincident vertices.
The API routes SAT versus SAB based on DXF target generation.
doesNotEstablish: arbitrary ACIS schema coverage or independent producer semantics
that mesh vertex counts survive body generation unchanged
curved analytic B-rep correctness from mesh projection or same-library readback
evidence.planUse: Keep ezdxf pinned and schema-bounded. For generated SAT/SAB witnesses, assert against an independently authored analytic manifest and record merge/profile settings, body closure, and unsupported data rather than treating source mesh vertex counts as topology proof.

existingOwnersOnly: S8 carrier/AcDs association and output retention
existing SAT/DXF carrier writer and framing tests
nextActions: Continue narrow local implementation slices and fast generated validation; do not add peer execution to the per-slice loop.
For carrier framing edits, include final-chunk, exact-byte/length, bounds, and following-record controls in the existing test owner.
At the composed DXF checkpoint only, use a pinned GDAL driver read/API call if already available; separate ASCII/Binary DXF and raw ASM/transform from projection and direct transcode.

At the composed ACIS checkpoint only, compare pinned ezdxf parser results and any eligible semantic reader against independent known-shape expectations; do not equate mesh projection with curved B-rep semantics.
For DWG AcDs changes, follow the local ODA specification and verify entity-handle/key/owner/prototype-to-payload association independently of an external shape result.
Keep peer/platform unavailability as NOT_RUN and continue implementation.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
